admission.justification: The builder, comparator, held-fold selection and disclosure must jointly preserve a single reachable chosen document even under cycles.

applicability: The non-flat Operations task hierarchy under its admitted parents.
conditions: Need ordering uses each entry own band, preserving supplied sibling order for ties.
Held selected ancestors cannot be collapsed.
exclusions: Widening admission or changing document hierarchy ownership.
Imposing hierarchical folds on the flat grouping.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/treeRows.test.ts (6 tests, among them "lists a row once when two completed parents name each other"); dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/hierarchy.test.tsx: "keeps the tree open down to the chosen document", "orders the tasks of a master by need and keeps the completed behind one line", "opens the line of completed ones by itself while the chosen document is behind it".

statement: Under a parent, Operations rows use each served entry own works/started/planned/terminal need band and stable supplied tree order, without a subtree urgency or chronology reconstruction. Terminal rows stand behind an in-place fold that is never the chosen task; selected ancestors remain open, hidden selected descendants reveal their fold, and cycle/seen guards list an entry once.
